name: local-meeting-notes
description: Private macOS meeting recorder and speech-to-text app: replaces Granola and Wispr Flow
author: Lucas Synnott

scripts.dist: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:worker && npm run build:zoom-observer && npm run build:hotkey && npm run build:calendar && npm run build:extract && npm run build:screens && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:worker && npm run build:zoom-observer && npm run build:hotkey && npm run build:calendar && npm run build:extract && npm run build:screens && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.build:hotkey: swiftc -O -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices -framework Carbon native/hotkey/main.swift -o native/hotkey/meeting-notes-hotkey
scripts.build:renderer: cd renderer && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.build:screens: swiftc -O -framework ScreenCaptureKit -framework Vision -framework AppKit native/screens/main.swift -o native/screens/meeting-notes-screens

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Meeting Notes records your selected microphone during meetings.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Meeting Notes records system and voice-chat audio for your private meeting notes.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Meeting Notes uses macOS screen capture to record system and voice-chat audio.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Meeting Notes names your calls after their calendar event and lists who was invited.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Meeting Notes names your calls after their calendar event and lists who was invited.
